name: numeric-conversion-test-6b3e1e5e00/invalid-decimal-as-byte-256-p.bal
spec_references: ## Module-level declarations: Function definition — Supports required-params
## Expressions: Literal — Currently support `nil-literal`, `boolean-literal`, `numeric-literal` and `string-literal` only
## Statements: Local variable declarations; Call; Panic
reason: The case calls a function with decimal value 256.0 and expects casting it to byte to panic because it exceeds the byte range. Function definitions, required parameters, numeric literals, calls, local declarations and type casts are supported, with no applicable restriction excluding this numeric conversion or its failure behavior.
test_design_notes: The @panic marker asserts runtime failure of the out-of-range decimal-to-byte cast.
